vectors.title: same id after the first attempt was refused for its proof: the corrected resend under the same id
spec: SPEC.md:1021 (7.2 item 11: keyed on id; the record is written at accepted, 4.12)
docs/05 V9 (VTI claims the id only after the proof verifies and releases a refused claim)
vectors.clarify: The framework keys the duplicate record on id and writes it at accepted; it does not say whether an attempt refused before acceptance (here for its proof) leaves the id free for a corrected resend. VTI releases a refused claim, so an unauthenticated sender cannot squat an id; an implementation that burns the id also keeps within the text. Not gating.

vectors.title: same id from another issuer: the second document is a different document under the same id
spec: SPEC.md:1033 (7.2 item 11, Keying and comparison: the key is the id)
vectors.clarify: Item 11 keys the record on id alone; whether the issuer is part of the key (so another issuer's reuse of the id is a new document) is not stated, and implementations differ. The vector asserts the id-only reading (idConflict). Not gating.
